# Card Game

> Real-time multiplayer card game platform — Django + Next.js + WebSockets + Neo4j

## Project

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/card-game)
- [English Website](https://cocodedk.github.io/card-game/)
- [Persian Website](https://cocodedk.github.io/card-game/fa/)

## Architecture

Multi-stack project:
- **Backend**: Django 5.0 + Django REST Framework + Django Channels (WebSockets) + Daphne ASGI — Python 3.12
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 + TypeScript 5.3 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 + TanStack Query — Node.js 20
- **Database**: Neo4j 5.16 (Neomodel ORM) + Redis 7.2 (WebSocket broker)
- **Infra**: Docker Compose (full stack), JWT authentication

## Key Files

- `backend/card_game/settings.py` — Django settings
- `backend/game/consumers.py` — WebSocket game consumers
- `backend/authentication/` — JWT auth implementation
- `frontend/src/` — Next.js pages, components, services
- `docker-compose.yml` — Full stack Docker orchestration
- `CLAUDE.md` — AI session startup guide
- `version.txt` — Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)

## Development

```bash
# Start full stack
docker-compose up

# Backend tests
cd backend && pytest tests/ -x

# Frontend tests + lint
cd frontend && npm test && npm run lint
```
